cases.question: How many annual leave days do full-time SaiTech employees receive?
cases.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
cases.answer: Full-time SaiTech employees receive 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year [Source 1].

cases.question: How many remote work days are permitted per week?
cases.expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
cases.answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval [Source 1].

cases.question: What is the monthly home internet reimbursement limit in the Expense Policy?
cases.expected_answer: Eligible remote employees may claim up to INR 1,500 per month for home internet.
cases.answer: The monthly home internet reimbursement limit is INR 1,500 [Source 1]. This limit is also mentioned in the Remote-Work-Policy.md as INR 1,500 per month for home internet with a valid bill under the Expense Policy [Source 3].

cases.question: What are our standard weekly working hours?
cases.expected_answer: The standard work week is Monday to Friday, 40 hours in total.
cases.answer: The standard work week is 40 hours in total, from Monday to Friday [Source 1].

cases.question: Which reviewer is required for changes to authentication code?
cases.expected_answer: Changes to authentication code require a Security reviewer.
cases.answer: A Security reviewer is required for changes to authentication code [Source 1].

cases.question: What is the SEV1 acknowledgement target?
cases.expected_answer: The on-call engineer acknowledges SEV1 incidents within 15 minutes.
cases.answer: The on-call engineer acknowledges SEV1 incidents within 15 minutes [Source 2].

cases.question: How long do Atlas data export download links remain valid?
cases.answer: Atlas data export download links expire after 24 hours [Source 1].

cases.question: What is the minimum password length in the SaiTech security policy?
cases.expected_answer: Use a unique password of at least 14 characters.
cases.answer: The minimum password length in the SaiTech security policy is 14 characters [Source 1].
